text:
maria: FYI — big enterprise customer asked for an SLA-backed dashboard that ties cost breakdown, trace heatmaps, and error slices to specific routes. They want acceptance criteria before legal signs off. Can we scope an MVP?
ken: TL;DR: we can ship a lightweight surface that links costs->route, basic trace sampling, and error buckets. Need to pick sampling rate and SLOs.
priya: Agree. We should avoid full trace retention for MVP. Propose: sampling 10% on prod by default, 100% for flagged routes. Also need an SLI for cost delta per 1k requests.
elaine: Product note — customer requires ability to pin routes to SLA groups and see monthly cost impact. UX must show per-route token breakdown and a clear recommended action (cache / quantize / batch).
sam: Ops check — 10% sampling will keep per-token bill manageable, but people will want low-latency histograms. We can pre-aggregate latencies into p50/p95/p99 w/o full span export.
maria: Can someone sketch acceptance criteria? Legal wants: (1) SLA defined (p95 < 350ms for selected routes), (2) cost alerting thresholds, (3) per-route retention policy.
ken: Draft acceptance criteria: 
- p95 latency surface for SLA routes populated with live traces (aggregated)
- Cost breakdown UI shows tokens + infra cost per route for last 30d
- Error analytics surface: top 10 failing routes with example payload snippets (sanitized)
- Sampling controls: global rate + per-route overrides
- Rollout: feature flag + canary to 10% accounts then 100%
(We can iterate visuals after engineering mocks)
priya: Quick config snippet for sampling control we can expose in the Console: 
```json
{"sampling": {"default_pct": 10, "overrides": [{"route": "/api/chat", "pct": 100}]}}
```
elaine: UX asks: default view should land on cost anomalies; allow sorting by SLA group. Can we show cost delta with confidence intervals?
sam: Backend note — confidence intervals require a small extra compute pass but ok for MVP if we cache daily. We'll need a data retention policy to satisfy compliance.
maria: Timeline ask from sales: demo-ready in 3 weeks for the customer negotiating contract. Realistic?
ken: 3 weeks tight but possible if we scope to: aggregated traces (no span waterfall), per-route token cost + infra estimate, error list + sample payloads, sampling controls. No complex UX polish.
priya: I'll own sampling controls + backend knobs. Can we drop per-route historical trend beyond 30d to save work?
elaine: Yes 30d is fine for demo. We can add 90d later.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: feature-flag "sla-dashboard-mvp" -> canary group 10% (start CI checks).
maria: OK assigning: priya (sampling + backend), ken (aggregation + SLA surface), elaine (UI mocks for 30d), sam (infra + retention), I'll coordinate with sales/legal. I'll post a checklist tomorrow. :thumbsup:
